translations.web: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
translations.bsb: The canals will stink; the streams of Egypt will trickle and dry up; the reeds and rushes will wither.
translations.kjv: And they shall turn the rivers far away; and the brooks of defence shall be emptied and dried up: the reeds and flags shall wither.
translations.asv: And the rivers shall become foul; the streams of Egypt shall be diminished and dried up; the reeds and flags shall wither away.
